root_cause.text: The vulnerability arises because the error handling paths in `wave5_vpu_open_enc()` and `wave5_vpu_open_dec()` fail to free the previously allocated VPU instance when the subsequent `codec_info` allocation fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `kfree(inst)` inside the `if (!inst->codec_info)` block in both `wave5-vpu-dec.c` and `wave5-vpu-enc.c`, correcting the omission described in the CVE where the instance was returned without being released upon allocation failure.
